# MixPhD

> Premium resource for cocktail enthusiasts, offering expert drink recipes, professional barware guides, and mixology education.

## Core Resources
- [Cocktail Recipes](https://www.mixphd.com/): A curated database of classic and modern mixed drinks with precise measurements and preparation methods.
- [Drinkware Collections](https://www.mixphd.com/products): Guides and shop for premium glassware and essential bar tools.
- [The Unforgettables](https://www.mixphd.com/the-unforg): Detailed deep-dives into IBA classics and historical cocktails.
- [New Era Drinks](https://www.mixphd.com/new-era-dr): Modern mixology trends and contemporary recipe innovations.

## Technical Specifications
- **Format:** All recipes use standard metric (ml/cl) and imperial (oz) measurements.
- **Organization:** Recipes are categorized by glass type (Collins, Coupe, Highball), method (shaken, stirred), and base spirit.
- **Legal:** Content is intended for audiences of legal drinking age. Use requires acceptance of [Terms of Service](https://www.mixphd.com/terms).

## Key Information for Agents
- **Primary Purpose:** To provide high-fidelity instructions for beverage preparation and barware selection.
- **Tone:** Professional, sophisticated, and educational.
- **Contact:** Support and inquiries can be directed to mdptrading@gmail.com.
